name: Solid glyph icon
region: Icon fonts on the web: Glyphicons and Font Awesome
summary: Icons as solid, one-colour silhouettes, like the glyphs of a bold typeface. Inner details are cut out of the fill as gaps. The style began with icon fonts and stays the default for small, high-contrast UI.

philosophy.core_thesis: An icon is a single solid mark, and a silhouette with cut-out details reads best at small sizes and on any ground.
design_principles: Draw a solid silhouette on a 24 × 24 px grid, or on the em square of an icon font.
Cut inner details out of the fill as gaps of 1.5–2 px at 24 px.
Use one colour per icon; the icon takes the text colour.
Keep the visual weight even: each icon covers 40–60% of its live area.
Give rectangles a corner radius of 1–2 px at 24 px.
Align the glyph to the text baseline when it is set in a line of text.
anti_patterns: Thin outlines next to solid shapes
More than one colour in a UI glyph
Uneven visual weight across the set

grid.keylines: A circle of 20 px and a square of 18 px; for a font, the glyph fills the em height with a sidebearing of 1/16 em.

stroke.rule: No stroke. The form is the fill; inner lines are negative gaps of 1.5–2 px.

shape.primitives: Solid silhouettes from circles, rectangles and rounded rectangles; gaps cut at 0°, 45° or 90°.
shape.optical_size: At 12–16 px, close small gaps and keep the outer silhouette; at 24 px and above, open the gaps.

colour.strategy: One colour, currentColor; the ground gives the contrast.

perspective_and_light.shadow: No shadow; the glyph is flat on the ground.

metaphor.typical: A house, a bell, a user, a trash can, a star, a heart and a magnifier.
metaphor.treatment: The silhouette of the object with 1 or 2 cut-out details.

emotion.target_response: Firm and clear: the user finds the action at once.

use_cases: buttons and small UI at 12–16 px
active state of an outline set
avoid_when: The UI is light and airy and the icons must recede.
The icon is the hero of a page and needs depth.

modifiers.how: Keep the silhouette and the grid; draw the edge as a 2 px stroke with round caps, and drop the fill.
Keep the solid main shape; set the secondary parts at 20–40% opacity of the same colour.

stroke_width.note: There is no stroke; the form is the fill.
